comment_event_check.name: comment_event_check
comment_event_check.value:
(
				"comment"."kind" = 'comment'
				and "comment"."event_type" is null
				and "comment"."event_from" is null
				and "comment"."event_to" is null
			) or (
				"comment"."kind" = 'event'
				and "comment"."event_type" in ('status', 'start_date', 'due_date', 'assignee_added', 'assignee_removed', 'estimate_minutes')
			)

milestone_dates_check.name: milestone_dates_check
milestone_dates_check.value: "milestone"."start_date" is null or "milestone"."due_date" is null or "milestone"."start_date" <= "milestone"."due_date"
